consent.banner.title: We ask before we track
consent.banner.body: Some features use cookies and similar technology to work well. You decide per purpose, and you can change your mind at any time from “Your privacy choices”.
consent.banner.gpcNotice: We detected a browser privacy signal (Global Privacy Control) and applied it. Accepting all would override it, so we will ask you to confirm first.
consent.override.title: Override your browser privacy signal?
consent.override.body: Your browser asked us not to sell or share your information. Accepting all overrides that signal — only continue if you mean it.
consent.notice.title: Notice at collection
consent.notice.body: Before you browse: this store collects the categories listed below. Opting out takes one click from any page and never requires an account.
consent.notice.saleShareSold: Personal information may be sold or shared for cross-context advertising until you opt out.
consent.notice.saleShareNotSold: Personal information is not sold or shared for cross-context advertising.
consent.purpose.essential.label: Essential
consent.purpose.essential.description: What the store needs to function.
consent.purpose.essential.consequence: Always on — cart, sign-in and security cannot work without it.
consent.purpose.analytics.label: Product analytics
consent.purpose.analytics.description: Which pages and features are used, counted in aggregate.
consent.purpose.analytics.consequence: Your browsing of this store is counted so we can improve it.
consent.purpose.marketing_email.label: Marketing email
consent.purpose.marketing_email.descript: News, offers and product announcements by email.
consent.purpose.marketing_email.conseque: Your email address is used for campaigns until you withdraw.
consent.purpose.ads_personalisation.desc: Ads on other sites picked for you.
consent.purpose.ads_personalisation.cons: Ad platforms receive information to select ads for you.
consent.purpose.ads_measurement.label: Ad measurement
consent.purpose.ads_measurement.descript: Whether ad clicks lead to purchases, in aggregate.
consent.purpose.ads_measurement.conseque: Ad platforms receive aggregate conversion signals.
consent.purpose.session_replay.label: Session replay
consent.purpose.session_replay.descripti: Recording how the interface is used to fix problems.
consent.purpose.session_replay.consequen: Interactions such as clicks and scrolls may be recorded.
consent.purpose.sale_or_share.label: Sale or sharing for cross-context advertising
consent.purpose.sale_or_share.descriptio: Sharing data with ad platforms so ads follow you across sites.
consent.purpose.sale_or_share.consequenc: Your data may be shared with the ad vendors listed below.
consent.purpose.targeted_advertising.des: Ads chosen based on your profile.
consent.purpose.targeted_advertising.con: Your profile may be used to select advertising.
consent.purpose.profiling_significant_ef: Automated decisions that could seriously affect you.
Decisions such as pricing or eligibility may be automated.
consent.purpose.sensitive_pi_use.label: Use of sensitive personal information
consent.purpose.sensitive_pi_use.descrip: Sensitive categories such as health or precise location.
consent.purpose.sensitive_pi_use.consequ: Limited to what the service strictly requires.
